allot.subject: Appointment
allot.text: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Anupam Kumar as Non- Executive (Govt. Nominee) Director of the company w.e.f. November 06, 2026 (I.e. Date of allotment of DIN).
